title: Extend the existing Memes v3 collector with deterministic launch-replay and pre-launch artifact provenance
objective: Extend, not replace, the existing Memes v3 empirical-hardening collector so chain-native launches can be replayed from exact launch state through sub-minute and later checkpoints. Preserve executable quotes, venue-specific opening taxes/fees/exemptions, quote-asset beta, graduation transitions, immutable availability timestamps and optional public-artifact provenance. Use FLYBRAIN as a high-value fixture and matched failures as mandatory controls. Do not create a parallel scheduler, scanner, signal engine, trade path or portfolio authority.

scope: bind exact launch transaction/block/time, chain, venue, token, curve/pool state, pairing asset and creator economics to the existing immutable discovery packet
support launch-relative observations at T+1s, T+2s, T+5s, T+10s, T+30s, T+60s and later configured checkpoints without mutating the launch row
store both raw venue state and executable quote after recipient-specific opening tax, standard fee, creator tax, price impact and latency
record launcher/creator/team opening-tax exemptions where deterministically observable
distinguish pre-graduation bonding-curve state from post-graduation Uniswap-pool state
preserve quote asset and deterministic quote-asset/USD decomposition rather than treating USD chart return as native token alpha
add optional public-artifact provenance fields with public_at separate from commit author/committer timestamps
capture repository creation/publication time, launch-specific artifact visibility, artifact-to-launch lead time and reproducible artifact identity links when present
capture first external scanner availability as provider-attributed evidence rather than canonical truth
bind visibility events and first-distribution followups to the existing empirical-hardening observation relation

test PRE_LAUNCH_ARTIFACT_PROVENANCE, ARTIFACT_EXECUTABILITY, NARRATIVE_TRUTH_DENSITY, AGENCY_DECOMPOSITION, SCANNER_LEAD_TIME, CREATOR_ECONOMIC_LOOP_INTENSITY and OPEN_SOURCE_FORKABILITY only as research features
compare each candidate feature against matched failed launches and copycat instances before any promotion

positive: FLYBRAIN launch fixture resolves exact Robinhood Chain CA, launch tx, block, timestamp, creator, GOOGL pairing asset, supply and creator tax from frozen evidence.
A Pons v2 T+1s/T+2s replay does not report curve price as executable return without applying the recipient-specific opening snipe tax and other required costs.
Creator/team tax exemptions remain separate from ordinary buyer execution and cannot be treated as public achievable fills.
Pre-graduation and post-graduation venue states are explicitly distinct.
Quote-asset return is preserved and USD return can be decomposed without model-mediated arithmetic.
Git commit author time cannot substitute for public artifact availability time.
External scanner labels remain provider-attributed and can conflict with deterministic chain reconstruction.
Every later observation appends to the frozen case rather than rewriting its T0 state.
Matched failed launches are required before any artifact-provenance or scanner-lead feature is promoted.
negative: No sub-second/early chart price may be treated as an executable entry without venue tax/fee/impact modelling.
No public GitHub repository, code velocity, KOL follow, scanner label or creator-fee claim may independently emit BUY/SELL/size or QUALIFIED_ALPHA.
No hindsight peak may rewrite an earlier feature.
No new scheduler, duplicate scanner, market-state owner, portfolio path or trade execution path may be introduced.
No workflow change, API budget increase, paid data acquisition or automatic merge is authorized by this candidate.
